basis: The active long-term goal requires closing the Loop28 Python/native parity blocker before building later Loop127 through Loop151 per-file adapters.
allowed: implement the bounded Python diagnostic orchestrator and synthetic tests
add native read-only keyed trace entry points plus their selftest wiring
build and verify a fixed hash-only implementation manifest without parsing split, prediction, metric, pickle, checkpoint, or model payloads
hash and validate the four parent evidence artifacts before any raw or model access
scan the complete split manifest metadata solely for identity integrity while selecting only the frozen train row
read only the single frozen train sample after exact index, SHA-256, size, split, and root checks
create exactly one private SHA-verified snapshot of that same sample
compare stage-level tensors, logits, probabilities, and Stage-2 feature vectors
run bounded keyed HMAC whole-component and block comparisons solely to localize the first divergence
atomically consume the single final run authorization with an immutable one-shot lease before any raw sample access
write a bounded diagnostic receipt only after a separate run authorization binds the final hash-only implementation manifest, implementation hashes, runtime hashes, generation, and output path
not_authorized: training, fitting, fine-tuning, calibration, threshold search, or model selection
cache creation, cache rebuild, feature-cache mutation, or cache replacement
split, label, raw sample, model, checkpoint, pickle, JSON model, or ONNX mutation
opening Val, Test-10k, legacy full-test, or any other heldout raw file, prediction, metric report, feature cache, or model-selection payload
reading a second raw identity or expanding the sample allowlist
GPU execution, network access, dependency installation, deployment, commit, or push
F1 estimation, candidate promotion, product-readiness claims, or complete Loop151 replay claims
accepted_residual_risks: Implementation and runtime artifacts are path-hash verified before execution and reverified before receipt write, but this diagnostic does not yet execute every artifact from a retained same-handle snapshot.
Concurrent adversarial A-to-B-to-A path replacement is outside this train-only localization claim and remains a certification blocker.
success_definition: The receipt identifies the earliest divergent stage and proves all preceding stage inputs match; parity success, parity failure, or decision agreement alone is insufficient.
